0022600026.text: Boston enters 6-2 and second in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, with a 1-2 road record, while Charlotte is 3-6, has lost five straight, and sits 10th in the East. Devin Carter is out with illness for Boston, and Jayson Tatum (rest) and Payton Pritchard (eye abrasion) are both day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Charlotte is missing Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (leg soreness), both out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Celtics won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 113-102 win in Boston on April 7, 2026.
